The most striking [[landmark]] in this area would be the library of [[Prince Mehtu the Wise]], named the [[Halls of Chokhin]], where researchers and philosophers gather to study and share knowledge on various fields of knowledge. The rest of the area is mountainous passes inhabited by [[insect]]s, [[harpy|harpies]], hostile [[plant]]s, and [[minotaur]]s. Fireflies can be seen beautifully lighting up the passes and open ground in the western half of this area. {{TOCright}} ==Getting there== This area lies beyond [[Mihanu Township]], which is found on the northwestern corner of [[the Mirror of Lyss]]. If your character goes with [[Margrid the Sly]] instead of the [[Master of Whispers]], then the [[primary quest]] [[Greed and Regret]] will lead your character here. ==Shrines== ;[[Resurrection
